episodes.synopsis: Takuma's classmates are so terrified of him that they're convinced he's responsible for the Akuma attacks across the city. The nine Valkyries he lives with know better.
episodes.title: The Fighting Maiden

episodes.synopsis: Itsuyo quickly became the student council president, but can she quickly level up before the next battle? Perhaps Takuma can help sate her desire.
episodes.title: The Binding Maiden

episodes.synopsis: Mutsumi is overjoyed she's finally on a date with Takuma! There's only one problem: She's an idol, so it could ruin both the date and her career if someone recognizes her.
episodes.title: The Secret Maiden

episodes.synopsis: Futaba is crazy strong and when she plays tag, she plays for keeps. The upcoming campus festival offers an opportunity for a date, but does danger lurk on the horizon?
episodes.title: The Serving Maiden

episodes.synopsis: The Valkyries have the perfect opportunity to level up at the campus festival. Unfortunately for them, their attendance gives Garum the chance he's been waiting for.
episodes.title: The Believing Maiden

episodes.synopsis: Futaba fights Garm as the other Valkyries face a fierce onslaught. Takuma and Natsuki prepare to take their relationship to the next level to save them.
episodes.title: The Naked Maiden

episodes.synopsis: "Dr." Takuma gives the Valkyries a physical examination. Afterwards, Misa starts a date with Takuma so Itsuyo can take notes.
episodes.title: The Reeling Maiden

episodes.synopsis: Mutsumi and Yakumo need to get stronger, fast! But that's easier said than done since Takuma finds Yakumo extremely intimidating.
episodes.title: The Strengthening Maiden

episodes.synopsis: As a third party plots their next move, Takuma must save Itsuyo from… Natsuki? Ichika is still level 1 and needs Takuma’s help. Too bad she thinks he’s pathetic.
episodes.title: The Touching Maiden and the Touched Maiden

episodes.synopsis: Natsuki has a hunch regarding what Takuma brought home from this store, and she doesn't like it one bit... so she takes matters into her own hands!
episodes.title: The Drunken Maiden

episodes.synopsis: Futaba fights Skuld and the akuma alone so Ichika and Takuma can launch a sneak attack. Everything goes according to plan until Takuma senses something’s wrong...
episodes.title: The Accepting Maiden

episodes.synopsis: Nine Valkyries descended from the heavens to fight akuma. But victory often comes at a price. There may only be eight Valkyries remaining when the dust settles...
episodes.title: The Loving Maiden!
